name: Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Ancara Logistics Indonesia Tbk delivers comprehensive maritime transport, cargo transfer, and supply chain management services. The company's primary focus is orchestrating the movement of coal utilizing barges. To ensure operational compliance, it possesses all necessary permits and certifications, including the Sea Transport Company Business Permit (SIUPAL), the International Safety Management (ISM) Code, and the International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code. Founded on July 30, 2019, the firm's corporate headquarters are situated in South Jakarta, Indonesia.
